obfuscate_java_code: obfuscate Java source code using javalang_obfuscator and return the obfuscated code with a deobfuscation dictionary
extract_java_functions_from_ast: extract class methods and standalone static functions from a Java AST node tree
remove_java_annotations: remove Override, Deprecated, or SuppressWarnings annotations from a Java method declaration string
